reason: Final Real Luna 3x merge gate after manual review of gate-17 found a hidden semantic directionality defect despite 3/3 green: user text meaning remaining work takes about 45 minutes could be stored as a minute workload or as effort on completed progress. Focused contextual semantics now expose a unique same-task remaining workload and let Luna distinguish effort on the pending target from explicit remaining-work effort; generic semantic policy preserves the same completed-versus-remaining direction. A dedicated Real API invariant now requires 70% completed + derived 30% remaining + remaining 45 minutes to bind total_duration=45 to the remaining fact, with no 45-minute workload and no 45-minute effort on completed progress. Prompt byte guards were only modestly relaxed to retain these semantics rather than deleting them. Revalidate final conversation, completed progress, remaining effort, typed renderer, all question codes, transcript, and Fact Graph invariants on this exact head.
